title: The Fidelity Frontier in Computational Psychiatry: Decomposing Acquisition and Encoding Loss in Psychopathology
domain: computational psychiatry / phenomenological psychopathology / neurophenomenology / psychometrics / mental-health measurement
summary: A measurement framework that separates how psychopathological experience is elicited from how a fixed evidential record is encoded. ARIS4C009 benchmarks same-source representations with blinded reconstruction tests, then treats phenomenological fidelity, reliability, intended-use validity, predictive utility, privacy and burden as distinct objectives on a use-conditioned Pareto frontier.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C guided research design; formal ARIS provenance to be frozen at full run
